business_question: Which synthetic portfolio segments show unusual monthly net principal movement or principal event activity?
result_grain: one row per loan account per calendar month of event effective date
population: Synthetic loan accounts opened on or before the as-of date with at least one in-scope principal event on or before the cutoff
exclusions: fee events (event_type FEE) and their reversal rows
reversed principal events removed together with their reversal rows (matched-pair semantics, EVD-0008)
duplicate extract rows suppressed by the event_id and account_id dedup guards (QR-001, QR-005)

metrics.name: net_principal_movement
metrics.formula: sum(event_amount) over in-scope principal events (DISBURSEMENT positive, PRINCIPAL_REPAYMENT negative), after matched-pair removal of reversed events and their reversal rows, grouped by calendar month of effective_date

metrics.name: principal_event_count
metrics.formula: count of in-scope principal event rows per calendar month after dedup and matched-pair reversal removal; fee events and reversal rows are not counted

currency_basis.conversion_rule: not converted - results remain partitioned by account currency; FX conversion policy is unresolved and tracked as EVD-0005, so no rate or base currency is applied

expected_row_behavior: One row per loan account per calendar month containing at least one in-scope principal event after dedup and matched-pair reversal removal. Months with no in-scope principal events produce no row (no calendar spine). Amounts stay in account currency; rows are never summed across currency_code.
validation_checks: row count equals the count of distinct (loan_account_id, event_month) pairs
per-currency sum of net_principal_movement ties to reconciliation control CTRL-002, partitioned by currency_code
reversal probe: dropped originals equal the number of in-scope REVERSAL rows with resolvable reversal_link_id (QR-004)
duplicate probe: zero event_id values with more than one scoped row before the dedup guard (QR-001)
NULL-amount probe: rows with NULL event_amount counted and listed separately (QR-002); excluded from sums, not silently dropped
